install.pitchMobile: Add Disscount to your Home Screen for quicker access.

install.perkDesktop: No app store download needed: install Disscount straight from your browser.
install.perkMobile: No app store download needed: add Disscount to your Home Screen straight from your browser.
install.sheetDescriptionDesktop: Install Disscount on your computer in a few steps.
install.sheetDescriptionMobile: Add Disscount to your Home Screen in a few steps.

steps.iosMenu: Tap next to the address bar, then Share. On older iPhones, Share is right there in the toolbar.
steps.iosAdd: Scroll down the menu and choose Add to Home Screen.
steps.macFile: Open the File menu in the menu bar at the top of your screen.
steps.androidMenu: Tap <vdots></vdots> to open the browser menu.
steps.androidChoose: Choose Install app or Add to Home Screen, depending on your browser.
steps.desktopIcon: Click <monitor></monitor> on the right side of the address bar.
steps.desktopMenu: If you don't see that icon, open the menu, then Save and share › Install page as app.
